solution:
The circles intersect at $x=1$, $y=\pm\sqrt{3}$. By symmetry, the common area is
$$A=4\int_1^2\sqrt{4-x^2}\,dx=4\left[\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{4-x^2}+2\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)\right]_1^2=\frac{8\pi}{3}-2\sqrt{3}.$$
